source: CCMAS B.Sc. Cybersecurity (khairun.edu.ng/?p=840); institution prefix removed from added courses.

courses.name: Introduction to Computing Sciences
courses.general_name: Introduction to Computer Science and Information Technology
courses.summary: History and generations of computers, hardware, software, operating systems, networks, number systems and the Internet, with productivity tools.

courses.name: Problem Solving
courses.summary: Problem analysis, algorithm design, flowcharts, pseudocode and basic programming constructs.

courses.name: Introduction to Computer Programming
courses.summary: First programming course: syntax, control flow, functions and debugging.

courses.name: Introduction to Application Packages
courses.summary: Word processing, spreadsheets, presentations and office tools.

courses.name: Communication in English
courses.general_name: Academic English: Communication Skills and Writing
courses.summary: Listening, speaking, reading comprehension, grammar and usage, paragraph and essay writing, summary writing, and formal letters and reports.

courses.name: Nigerian Peoples and Culture
courses.general_name: Nigerian Peoples, Cultures and Heritage (African Studies)
courses.summary: Survey of Nigeria's major ethnic groups, pre-colonial states, colonial rule, religion, family, arts and the cultural values behind national identity and unity.

courses.name: Introduction to Information and Communication Technology
courses.general_name: Introduction to Information and Communication Technology
courses.summary: ICT concepts, devices, networks, the Internet and digital literacy.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics I
courses.general_name: Pre-calculus: Algebra, Trigonometry and Coordinate Geometry
courses.summary: Sets, number systems, polynomials, inequalities, functions, logarithms, trigonometry, complex numbers and sequences.

courses.name: Elementary Mathematics II
courses.summary: Limits, continuity, differentiation, applications of derivatives, integration, areas and volumes, and basic differential equations.

courses.name: General Physics I
courses.general_name: Introductory Mechanics and Properties of Matter
courses.summary: Units and dimensions, vectors, kinematics, Newton's laws, work, energy, momentum, rotational motion, gravitation, elasticity and fluids.

courses.name: General Physics II
courses.summary: Electric fields, potential, capacitance, DC circuits, magnetism, induction, AC basics, then waves and optics.

courses.name: General Practical Physics I
courses.summary: Measurement, error analysis and experiments in mechanics, heat and properties of matter, with report writing.

courses.name: General Practical Physics II
courses.summary: Experiments in electricity, magnetism, optics and waves, with graph work and error analysis.

courses.name: Descriptive Statistics
courses.summary: Data types, summary measures, graphs, probability basics and introduction to distributions.

courses.name: Computer Programming I
courses.summary: Variables, control structures, functions, arrays and structured programming in a high-level language.

courses.name: Computer Programming II
courses.summary: Classes and objects, inheritance, polymorphism, file handling, exceptions and larger programs.

courses.name: Data Structures
courses.summary: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hashing and their complexity.

courses.name: Algorithms and Complexity Analysis
courses.summary: Sorting, searching, divide and conquer, greedy and dynamic programming, graph algorithms and Big-O analysis.

courses.name: Introduction to Cybersecurity and Strategy
courses.summary: Threats, attacks, vulnerabilities, CIA triad, risk, security policy and national cyber strategy.

courses.name: Cybercrime, Law and Countermeasures
courses.summary: Types of cybercrime, Nigerian cyber law and investigation and prevention.

courses.name: SIWES I
courses.summary: Supervised short industrial placement (about 9 weeks) after second year: workplace observation, logbook and a placement report.

courses.name: Entrepreneurship and Innovation
courses.summary: Types of enterprise, opportunity spotting, business ideas, innovation, simple business plans, startup financing and the Nigerian small-business environment.

courses.name: Philosophy, Logic and Human Existence
courses.general_name: Introduction to Philosophy, Formal Logic and Ethics
courses.summary: Branches of philosophy, the nature of knowledge and existence, deductive and inductive reasoning, fallacies and argument analysis, and basic moral theory.

courses.name: Computer Architecture and Organization
courses.summary: CPU, memory and I/O organisation and instruction execution.

courses.name: Systems Analysis and Design
courses.summary: Requirements gathering, modelling with UML and data-flow diagrams, system design and implementation planning.

courses.name: Number Theory
courses.summary: Divisibility, congruences, primes and applications in cryptography.

courses.name: Introduction to Software Engineering
courses.summary: Software life cycle, requirements, design, testing, maintenance, version control and agile methods.

courses.name: Operating Systems
courses.summary: Processes, scheduling, memory management, file systems, concurrency and deadlock.

courses.name: Artificial Intelligence
courses.summary: Search, knowledge representation, logic, planning, uncertainty and introductory machine learning.

courses.name: Cryptography Techniques, Algorithms and Applications
courses.summary: Symmetric and public-key cryptography, hashing, signatures and protocols.

courses.name: Biometrics Security
courses.summary: Fingerprint, face and iris recognition, enrolment and biometric system security.

courses.name: Cybersecurity Risk Analysis, Challenges and Mitigation
courses.general_name: Cybersecurity Risk Analysis, Challenges and Mitigation
courses.summary: Risk assessment, controls, frameworks and incident response.

courses.name: Information and Big Data Security
courses.summary: Data protection, privacy, access control and securing big-data platforms.

courses.name: Digital Forensics and Investigation Methods
courses.summary: Evidence acquisition, disk and memory forensics and chain of custody.

courses.name: Cybersecurity Innovation and New Technologies
courses.summary: Security of IoT, AI, cloud and blockchain and emerging threats.

courses.name: SIWES II
courses.summary: Supervised 12-week placement after third year with deeper hands-on work in a firm, a logbook and an assessed report.

courses.name: Data Management I
courses.summary: Relational model, ER modelling, SQL, normalisation and database design.

courses.name: Venture Creation
courses.summary: Turning an idea into a registered business: market research, business model, financing, legal registration, marketing and a start-up plan.

courses.name: Peace and Conflict Resolution
courses.summary: Causes and types of conflict, Nigerian conflict case studies, negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and peace-building institutions.

courses.name: Data Communication Systems and Networks
courses.summary: Signals, transmission media, OSI/TCP-IP models, LAN/WAN, routing, protocols and network security basics.

courses.name: Research Methodology and Technical Report Writing
courses.general_name: Research Methods and Technical Report Writing
courses.summary: Research design, data collection and analysis, referencing, technical report and thesis writing.

courses.name: Systems Vulnerability Assessment and Testing
courses.summary: Scanning, penetration testing and vulnerability reporting.

courses.name: Steganography: Access Methods and Data Hiding
courses.general_name: Steganography: Access Methods and Data Hiding
courses.summary: Hiding data in media and detecting it.

courses.name: Cyber Threat Intelligence and Cyber Conflict
courses.general_name: Cyber Threat Intelligence and Cyber Conflict
courses.summary: Threat actors, intelligence collection and state-level cyber operations.

courses.name: Cloud Computing Security
courses.summary: Securing cloud services, identity, encryption and compliance.

courses.name: Ethical Hacking and Reverse Engineering
courses.summary: Authorised attack techniques, exploit analysis and binary reverse engineering.

courses.name: Deep and Dark Web Security
courses.summary: Anonymity networks, hidden services and threat monitoring.

courses.name: Network Security
courses.summary: Firewalls, VPNs, intrusion detection and secure network design.

courses.name: Malware Analysis
courses.summary: Static and dynamic analysis of malicious code and defence.

courses.name: Final Year Project I
courses.general_name: Final Year Project I (Proposal and Design)
courses.summary: First part of the final-year project: topic selection, literature review, method and preliminary results.

courses.name: Final Year Project II
courses.general_name: Final Year Project II (Implementation and Defence)
courses.summary: Second part: implementation, results, dissertation writing and oral defence.

courses.name: Blockchain Technology and Application
courses.summary: Distributed ledgers, consensus, smart contracts and applications.

courses.name: Open-Source Software Development and Applications
courses.summary: Open-source licensing, collaboration, Git and community contribution.
